requiredFindings.title: The bootstrap directory is identified by the inventory that lives inside it
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The image embeds a root binding and no path. The producer reads embeddedBootstrap.directory from the inventory in order to open that inventory, then lists the core tree and selects a file whose root binding equals the embedded digest. A second file with the same binding, or a name that sorts last, becomes the anchor. The kernel CodeDirectory join still passes. Scanning platforms for a matching entrypoint admits a row other than the authenticated profile's platform id.
